title: Project 2 — Stability Optimization
text:
Problem
Consider the eigenvalue problem
\[
Av_i=\lambda_i v_i.
\]
The sensitivity of an eigenvalue to parameter \(k\) can be written as
\[
\frac{\partial \lambda_i}{\partial k}
=
\frac{w_i^H \left(\frac{\partial A}{\partial k}\right) v_i}
{w_i^H v_i}.
\]
